summary: Apollo Infrastructure Company LLC filed a Form 8-K reporting unregistered sales of equity and a transactional net asset value update. As of September 1, 2026, it sold 2,294,628 shares across Series I and II classes for about $68.07 million cash to third-party accredited and non-U.S. investors under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D and Regulation S, with final share counts set September 25, 2026. The operating manager set August 31, 2026 transactional NAV per share between $28.55 and $30.75. This is routine continuous private-placement issuance and NAV disclosure for a non-traded vehicle, not a special situation.
